newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Jose Oil changes name to Fil-Estate.
newsitem.headline: San Jose Oil changes name to Fil-Estate.

text.p: The board of Philippine oil exploration company San Jose Oil said on Monday its newly elected board has approved a change in name to Fil-Estate Corporation.

In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company said the board also approved the subscription of Fil-Estate Management Inc, the parent company of Fil-Estate Land, to 700 million pesos worth of San Jose Oil shares in exchange for assets.
Company officials said this amounted to 70 percent of the authorised capital of the company.
One of the assets include Fil-Estate Management's 23 percent interest in Metro Rail Transit Corp, operator of the country's third light rail transit.
San Jose Oil earlier said the oil exploration firm will be converted into a holding company.
